Hand-inked 2D manga adventure drawing, strong uneven dark ink contours, flat cel colors with very limited shadows, clear simplified foliage, vivid cyan sky and small coral/yellow accents; a graphic screenprinted energy, not 3D, not realistic, not painterly, no soft-rendered volume.
